correctness.rationale: For independent Brownian first passage and exponential mortality, the exact defective density is \(f_q(u)=\exp[-1/(4u)-q^2u]/(2\sqrt\pi\,u^{3/2})\), whose integral is \(e^{-q}\). The successful time is centered at its exact conditional mean and standardized by its exact standard deviation. The analytic proof obtains an integrated Edgeworth expansion with exponentially controlled tails, yielding \(d_{\rm TV}(\nu_q,\mathcal N(0,1))=C_*/\sqrt q+O(q^{-1})\), where \(C_*=(1+4e^{-3/2})/(2\sqrt{2\pi})\). Independent Bernoulli mark thinning and Le Cam coupling give the process-level total-variation upper bound, and an exactly-one-point event in the density-sign-positive region proves the matching lower bound. Conditioning on the unique first successful arrival makes the remaining living indicators independent Bernoulli, with the probability derived exactly from killed Brownian survival and no earlier success. Uniform compact-time asymptotics and growing binomial means imply the joint survivor log-clock anti-correlation. The standalone checker executed 239 deterministic consistency tests of density, moments, CDF, moment-generating function, leading TV constant, critical first-arrival probabilities and living-population means. Finite checks are not substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: The reported new claim is the critically balanced synchronized-launch marked Poisson-Gaussian arrival and logarithmic living-population law, with sharp process-level total-variation rate and exact conditional single-mark coefficient. Existing exact hitting and first-success formulas, known threshold, conditional moments, the qualitative inverse-Gaussian TV normal approximation, and the exact conditional population-binomial mechanism are explicitly excluded from novelty. Full-text, implication-level comparisons did not find the combined joint critical limit or its sharp quantitative rate, but a classical equivalent may exist and independent priority validation remains outstanding.
residual_risks: The present critical-window law may be algebraically extractable from the powerful general finite-N first-arrival and survivor identities already published; publication-priority confirmation requires an independent specialist review.
A broader unlocated first-passage or inverse-Gaussian marked-Poisson asymptotic could subsume some or all of this specific law.

value.rationale: The finite initial population with mortality tuned to q=log(N)+c is a natural regime of stress redundancy, in which there are finitely many successful searches with positive probability of complete failure. A complete joint marked arrival law, exact calibration of a sharp strong-approximation rate, and a logarithmic living-population observable that is deterministically coupled to the first-arrival fluctuation directly address the biologically and physically motivated question of how many workers remain when an unlikely target search finally succeeds. This is a nontrivial distribution-level answer not supplied by first two moments or success threshold alone; the theorem makes no unsupported claim of applicability beyond independent Brownian/exponential-mortality searchers.
